The symbol "flash_swap_append" corresponds to a function that appends a program segment to a flash image, starting at a given offset and continuing until the end of the segment. This matches the description of adding an ascending piece of an erase-aligned swap image.

The symbol "flash_swap_rewrite" corresponds to a function that rewrites a block of data in a spare sector, effectively erasing and replacing it, which aligns with the description of swapping or rewriting an arbitrary program-page-aligned range.
